accuracy.detail: Disease classifier performs excellently (0.98+) on noisy multi-phase data.

robustness.detail: Model trained on stochastic multi-phase drift profiles covered by AR(1) noise.

early_detection.detail: 24% at 24h is realistic but falls short of the ≥40% target.

economic_utility.detail: 77% milk loss reduction (target ≥45%). Highly valuable despite FPs.

false_positive_burden.detail: 50 FP/wk at optimal threshold (target ≤5). Environmental noise causes false positives.

improvements_from_v8.realism: Replaced deterministic single sigmoid with 3-phase stochastic drift and AR(1) correlated noise.
improvements_from_v8.statistical_confidence: Scaled from 4 test episodes to 25 test episodes.

next_steps.fp_reduction: Need sequence models (RNN/Transformer) to distinguish disease drift from environmental noise.
next_steps.early_detection: Need self-supervised pretraining on healthy history to detect anomaly trajectories earlier.
